info.title: Recranet Booking API
info.description: The **Recranet Booking API** is the main API to access all features of [Recranet Booking](https://recranet.com/en/reservation-software).

parameters.name: general
parameters.description: Indicates if only generally available AgeGroupSpecifications should be shown.

post.summary: Checkin all persons for a reservation.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Reference date for dateFrom and dateTo. Options: date=reservation date or dateFrom=reservation from date or dateTo=reservation to date or period=reservation date-from overlap

get.summary: Get cancellation insurance lines for Reservation entity.
Get additional guests of Reservation entity.

Validate discount code specification is eligible for reservation.

put.description: Update the transaction, synchronize the status with the provider.

delete.description: Delete the transaction. This is only allowed if the transaction is removable.

get.summary: Lookup Reservation entity by phone number.

get.description: Can be used to retrieve a list of users for a given EasySecure configuration, Reservation or single Guest. For example, to display a list of EasySecure users for a given reservation, add the reservation query parameter.

put.description: Can be used to update some details of an EasySecure user. The most important property is gdprConsent. Show a GDPR consent form to the user to update this property before uploading a photo.

post.description: The gdprConsent property of the ESUser needs to be set to true before calling this endpoint. The user needs to be presented with a GDPR approval form first before uploading any photo to EasySecure.The request body needs to be a multipart request. The photo should be added as a part with the name file. Only photos with extensions JPG and PNG can be uploaded to EasySecure.
